# transport

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

:::

Bounded private transport values without credential or dispatch authority.

`connectors.transport` is one of connectors's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `HttpResponsePrefix`

`connectors.transport.HttpResponsePrefix` is a record of four fields:

- `status` — `Integer`
- `headers` — `Map<String, String>`
- `body` — `List<Integer>`
- `complete` — `Boolean`

### `PrivateReadBudget`

`connectors.transport.PrivateReadBudget` is a record of five fields:

- `deadline_ticks` — `Integer`
- `execution_ms` — `Integer`
- `provider_ms` — `Integer`
- `input_bytes` — `Integer`
- `result_bytes` — `Integer`

Every value satisfies `(execution_ms >= 1 and execution_ms <= 40000)`, `(provider_ms >= 1 and provider_ms <= 30000)`, `(input_bytes >= 1 and input_bytes <= 262144)` and `(result_bytes >= 1 and result_bytes <= 4194304)`.

### `TextBodyOutcome`

`connectors.transport.TextBodyOutcome` is one of `text`, `capacity` and `upstream_protocol`.

### `UpgradeBounds`

`connectors.transport.UpgradeBounds` is a record of three fields:

- `max_message_bytes` — `Integer`
- `max_total_bytes` — `Integer`
- `timeout_ms` — `Integer`

Every value satisfies `(max_message_bytes >= 1 and max_message_bytes <= 16777216)`, `(max_total_bytes >= 1 and max_total_bytes <= 67108864)` and `(timeout_ms >= 1 and timeout_ms <= 120000)`.

### `UpgradeOutcome`

`connectors.transport.UpgradeOutcome` is one of `not_sent`, `answered`, `lost` and `accepted`.

### `UpgradedStreamEnd`

`connectors.transport.UpgradedStreamEnd` is one of `closed`, `lost`, `truncated` and `deadline`.

Six of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors.transport.HttpResponsePrefix`, `connectors.transport.PrivateReadBudget`, `connectors.transport.TextBodyOutcome`, `connectors.transport.UpgradeBounds`, `connectors.transport.UpgradeOutcome` and `connectors.transport.UpgradedStreamEnd`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
